verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents power-delivery details (12 PSUs in N+N redundancy, AC/PDU and DC/busbar versions) but gives no power envelope figure such as TDP or system watts. It also contains no performance-per-watt data, first-party or independent. PSU redundancy is an adjacent power-reliability feature, not evidence that sustained workloads run efficiently, and the community remark about home circuits is speculation rather than a measurement.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
